text_block_list.text:
One day, after winning numerous races 
together with Neo Universe—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, Neo Universe has a report for 
you.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
The surface has finally "stabilized." With 
this, a prolonged water landing is 
possible. In other words—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: It's the "ideal temperature."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... you cannot perceive it, can 
you? Which means—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Right here.
choice_data_list: Is this... a hot spring inn!?

text_block_list.text:
It felt like I arrived in an instant. No, 
it must just be my imagination.

I decided to think of it as having spent 
the entire day traveling by train.
In the bath...

Neo Universe…… went to take a dip in the 
hot springs and never came back.

One hour, two hours, three hours... I'm 
starting to get genuinely worried now...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: —Phew... "The Earth was blue," indeed.
choice_data_list: Welcome back. Were you cooling off?
Welcome back. Were you cooling off?

text_block_list.text:
For someone who took such a long bath, her 
expression was completely nonchalant. It 
was hard to believe she hadn't just been 
resting somewhere, but...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Cooling off"... wasn't what I was doing. 
I was directly above... the mantle.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Pre-breeze"... I've been synching with it 
all along to prevent hypothermia.

In other words... you've been soaking in 
the hot spring this entire time.
choice_data_list:
Are you sure you haven't gotten dizzy from 
the bath?!

Are you sure you haven't gotten dizzy from 
the bath!?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Temperature in Fahrenheit... 96.8 °F. 
—"Normal body temperature."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe is "minor." Because it's 
"SERF."

Apparently, her body temperature is super 
stable. Now that she mentions it...

Normally, Umamusume flush red after a 
race. However, Neo Universe was...

I've never seen her flush. Perhaps there's 
nothing to worry about, but...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, Neo Universe requests a task. A 
'thermal conduction probe'."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: The scanning method—'Forehead Bonk'.

...It seems she's trying to touch 
foreheads to check my temperature.

...For just a moment, I decided to do as I 
was told.
—*Tap*.
The forehead I touched was...

Her temperature was indeed normal. I 
breathed a sigh of relief.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe verified too. Trainer is 
"normal body temperature" as well.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Then let's go to the hot springs again...

For a split second, static seemed to 
flicker in Neo Universe's blue eyes. A 
reaction unlike any before...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, Neo Universe has...... Detected 
it."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Body temperature, rising rapidly... 
97.0... 97.2... 97.4...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Physical contact... with Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Leave Neo Universe behind... and return...

An unforeseen incident. I hurriedly give 
her some water to calm her down.

Before long, everything returned to 
normal.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you," Trainer. Neo Universe is 
"learning." This 'Hot Springs Plan' is—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"It's full of the threats of the 'unknown' 
and 'heart-pounding excitement.' It's 
'unsaved.'"

Finally returning to her usual wavelength, 
Neo Universe showed a quiet smile.

It was a moment where I felt an 
irreplaceable bond with Neo Universe...
